All Nighters

Indie-rock band with 3–4 piece lineups, killer setlists & huge energy. From tipis to O2 arenas, All Nighters always bring the party and pack the dancefloor.

About All Nighters

All Nighters is a slick indie-rock band bringing epic energy to dancefloors across the UK. Available as a 3 or 4-piece lineup , they’ve been performing together since 2014 and have rocked everything from castles to O2 arenas , delivering tight, polished sets that never fail to get the party started. Led by full-time frontman Laurent , with Ewan on bass, Paolo on guitar, and Thomas on drums—all seasoned session musicians and educators —the band’s talent speaks for itself. Between them, they’ve supported Boy George , Nile Rodgers &amp; Chic , Demi Lovato , and Emeli Sandé , and gone viral with a cover of Wonderwall that landed them on BBC News and Good Morning Britain . With over 250 songs in their repertoire— indie, pop, rock, soul, folk , and more—All Nighters are happy to tailor your setlist and learn special requests. With pro PA, lighting , and a friendly band manager to handle logistics, they offer a seamless experience from first enquiry to final encore.
